'''Domain Skell''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Domain]] among the [[Intendant caste]]. Later on, it included warriors, possibly due to the integration of the castes on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
